cash_return: Gross unit-notional executable directional cash P&L, including the original audited corporate-action accounting.
floor_rationale: Fixed engineering choice; not selected using realised performance or tuning.
inputs: Independently verified cached executable-return and drawdown summaries only. No prices, feature values, models or cloud reads.
loss_policy: Literal signed ratio, including loss-ranking inversion and exact -1 ties; no sign-dependent transform.
missingness: No label or target imputation, clipping, winsorisation, hindsight stock removal or loss-dependent rank repair.
model_protocol: No estimator, selection score or compute run authorised by this engineering protocol.

path.entry: First trading open after signal month-end
path.marks: Same audited open/close unit NAV path including initial NAV=1
path.maximum_drawdown: Positive maximum peak-to-trough decline divided by running peak, with initial peak=1

payoffs.completion: Actual next-open exit no later than signal date
payoffs.interpretation: Expected ratio and expected cash return are distinct scores; neither relabels archived original RET.
payoffs.missing_cell_policy: Withhold entire vector; no shortening or skipped months
separate_outputs: historical mean ratio conditional on new ratio classes
historical mean executable cash return conditional on new ratio classes

preservation: Original runs, features, daily data, training/basket/stop/cost rules and deferred execution gaps unchanged.
protected_data: December 2023 outcome metadata only; no 2024+ financial values decoded. Integrity hashing is separate from financial decoding.

ranking.nonexhaustive_requests: Withhold classes for entire affected month/side
ranking.prediction_cohort: Unchanged original historical PIT eligible cohort; future availability never changes admission
ranking.tie_rule: Exact descending-value midrank: min(10,1+floor(10*(lower+upper)/(2*N))) for a zero-based half-open tie group. Preserve ties, never jitter or force equal class sizes.

source_certification: Derived formula/rank/clock verification does not certify underlying identity, action, investability or market-data correctness.

training_audit.purge: Only outcomes actually completed by last session before outer year
